summary: A routine Form 6-K furnished by foreign private issuer Intermap Technologies Corporation announced the timing of its second quarter 2026 financial results release and a related investor webcast scheduled for August 13, 2026. Chairman and CEO Patrick A. Blott and CFO Jennifer Bakken will host the call. The filing contains no transaction, no changes in control, no financing event, and no structural corporate action. It is purely an earnings announcement notice with forward-looking statements typical of such communications.
